crossRefs.note: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
But Yahweh sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to…
So they took up Jonah, and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.
He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there…
The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
“Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
Ah, the uproar of many peoples, who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations, that rush like the…
The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be…
When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward, and fell to the ground.

translations.web: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
translations.bsb: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
translations.kjv: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
translations.asv: Who stilleth the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.
